records.source: ``selected_keys`` carries the complete table selection; the legacy ``selected_key`` also retains the active key used by linked plots. ``symbol_by`` and ``opacity_by`` independently record the chosen marker-shape and opacity columns, including ``None`` for an unused channel, so an empty shape channel does not change opacity's role.

records.source: dict as :meth:`plot_state` returns it; keys it lacks keep their current value. Nothing applies when it is not a dict or no table is loaded. An explicit ``None`` colour disables colouring. Older states containing only ``selected_key`` remain supported.
